## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe what triggers the problem and how this change improves the outcome.

## Validation

Record checks actually performed, including relevant regression coverage. Distinguish mocked provider tests from live acceptance and identify verification gaps.

## Compatibility and data handling

Describe any change to tool contracts, account/customer scope, stored data, retention, provider permissions or approval requirements. Link updated documentation where needed. Never include tokens, private messages or customer identifiers.
